content.short: Tidal Finance is a decentralized discretionary mutual cover protocol.
content.description: Tidal Finance is a decentralized insurance protocol that provides protection against the potential failure of a protocol or asset. It operates with two participant roles: cover buyers and reserve providers, and employs peer-to-pool lending to back reserves, aiming to deliver favorable rates. This arrangement attracts both providers and buyers, as buyers pay a lower premium and lenders feel secure in their investment. By aligning incentives and directing liquidity toward protected instruments, Tidal Finance seeks sustainable risk coverage across its supported networks.
